events.name: New England Revolution at CF Montréal

headlines.description: Prince Owusu scored an equalizer in the 59th minute, and CF Montréal erased a two-goal halftime deficit to draw the New England Revolution 2-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montreal fights back to get draw with visiting Revs

headlines.description: Tai Baribo equalized in the 77th minute to help D.C. United rally for a 2-2 draw against Nashville SC on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: D.C. United rally from 2 goals down to draw with Nashville

events.name: Atlanta United FC at Philadelphia Union

headlines.description: Ezekiel Alladoh scored the winner in the 97th minute, one minute after Neil Pierre equalized the match, as the Philadelphia Union rallied from two goals down to beat Atlanta United 3-2 on Saturday in stoppage time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Philadelphia mount stunning late rally to beat Atlanta

events.name: Orlando City SC at Red Bull New York

headlines.description: Mijahir Jiménez scored two goals in his first MLS start, Emil Forsberg added another in the 43rd minute and the New York Red Bulls beat Orlando 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jiménez nets brace in 1st MLS start as Red Bulls beat Orlando

events.name: Columbus Crew at Inter Miami CF

headlines.description: Brais Méndez scored a late equalizer in his MLS debut and the Columbus Crew played Inter Miami to a 2-2 draw on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crew play Miami to a 2-2 draw as Lionel Messi returns

events.name: Charlotte FC at Chicago Fire FC

headlines.description: Robert Lewandowski scored two goals, including the winner, in his home debut for the Fire, helping Chicago beat Charlotte FC 2-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lewandowski scores twice in Chicago home debut

video.headline: Lewandowski scores brace on Chicago Fire home debut
